headlines.title: House advances bill to rein in AI data center utility costs
headlines.summary: The bipartisan legislation would create a regulatory framework states could adopt to prevent data center-related energy costs from being passed on to consumers.

headlines.title: Intel’s stock rises as investors hope memory chips can mark the next step in its turnaround
headlines.summary: A report says Intel is in early talks with SK Hynix, which is considering some sort of partnership that would enable it to make memory chips in the U.S.

headlines.title: Musk’s long-time backer is giving SpaceX stock to its investors
headlines.summary: Valor Equity Partners is handing out stock to its LPs instead of cash returns.

headlines.title: Trump says he still has confidence in Fed Chair Warsh, demands 1% or lower interest rates
headlines.summary: President Donald Trump previously threatened to cut off trade with countries that have trade surpluses with the U.S. if the Fed doesn't cut interest rates.

headlines.title: Al Gore has a surprisingly calm take on the AI data center backlash
headlines.summary: In an interview with TechCrunch, Al Gore suggested he isn't losing sleep over AI data center emissions — he's more worried about the AI industry's own warnings about where the technology is headed.

headlines.title: OpenAI reports 6 new instances of 'concerning model behavior' since March
headlines.summary: OpenAI has disclosed six new cases of model misbehavior and offered a framework for disclosing future instances, as the debate over AI model safety intensifies.

headlines.title: US automakers could soon be forced to include AM radio for free
headlines.summary: The House of Representatives, in rare bipartisan support, overwhelmingly approved legislation that would require new vehicles to include AM radio.

headlines.title: House passes sweeping Russia sanctions bill honoring Lindsey Graham, sends to Trump
headlines.summary: The Lindsey Graham Russia sanctions bill is on a path to become law after the House votes in favor.

headlines.title: As Fed rolls out its first interest-rate hike in 3 years, market braces for more increases
headlines.summary: The Fed’s policy-making committee was unanimous in its decision to hike, but forward guidance was split.

headlines.title: My rental property is paid off, but I need cash. Is this a bad time to take out a $50,000 HELOC?
headlines.summary: The Federal Reserve announced a quarter-percentage-point interest-rate hike Wednesday, to a range of 3.75%-4.0%.

headlines.title: ‘There might be a silver lining’: My friend’s wife died at 60 after a high-earning career. Can he claim her Social Security?
headlines.summary: “They had been married for over 30 years when she passed.”

headlines.title: Generac’s stock soars more than 30% after Amazon deal cements company’s status as an AI power player
headlines.summary: First deliveries of Generac’s backup power generators are worth $2.4 billion.
